description: Use when an ARC grid shows a partial motif and blank regions separated by a marker. Infer the motif's periodic continuation from demonstrations.

# ARC periodic pattern propagation

When demonstrations show a sparse colored motif in an otherwise uniform/background grid:

1. Identify the background color and any separator/boundary rows or columns; treat separators as structural and preserve them.
2. Compare demo input and output to determine the propagation direction and period. A motif may repeat by row blocks, column blocks, or both.
3. Preserve existing non-background cells and extend the observed pattern into blank regions using the demonstrated period and alignment.
4. Do not fill across a separator unless examples establish that behavior; a solid marker row may divide a source pattern from the region to be completed.
5. Verify dimensions and retain all unaffected cells before submitting.
